sections.title: Blood Pressure Treatment Chart
sections.focus: Each condition's blood-pressure target and first-line agent — read the chart row by row.

sections.title: Hemodynamic Pressure Table
sections.focus: Normal ranges for each hemodynamic parameter and what each reflects. Note the document's own ambiguities (an unlabelled two-range PAP row, SV without units) — do not write questions that hinge on them.

sections.title: Stroke Scales
sections.focus: Each stroke scale: what it scores, the positive/LVO threshold, the components, and how to interpret a given finding. RACE and LAPSS are image pages (OCR backs the validator).
